title: QA: Staging into main
eyebrow: QA for pull request 437, which brings the Wick, the fear art and the lair loot saves into main · nothing here is closed until you have tested

unverified: I have not played it by hand: every check was run by a script
I did not run lair_pile_check.sh on the merged branch. I ran only coop_lair_check.sh.

When a player is caught and dies, the death shows only on their own machine, and the other machine still reads health 100. The last recorded run of #436's own Wick check (run4) shows the same thing, so this merge did not cause it, but it is not fixed.

short.lead: Pull request 437 carries three pull requests into main in one go: #436, the Wick; #414, the fear art, which #436 already holds in full; and #422, which saves lair loot. I merged them one at a time on a new branch and ran the checks after each. Every check passed in the logs I read. None of it has been played by hand.

Host a co-op game with a friend joining. Let a Lantern Warden see you, so it turns into the Wick. Then come home, move one piece of loot in the Lair's pile, quit to the menu and host again.
Tell me whether the Wick looked right on both screens, and whether the piece was still where you left it after you hosted again.
